from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
root=Path("/home/appontrack/public_html")
p=root/"_core/Signup.php"
old="تم تأكيد البريد وإنشاء حساب شركتك. سجل الدخول لإعداد المصادقة الثنائية."
new="تم تأكيد البريد وإنشاء حساب شركتك. سجّل الدخول ببريدك وكلمة المرور."
assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
before=p.read_text()
assert before.count(old)==1 or (before.count(new)==1 and old not in before),"unexpected_signup_source"
changed=old in before
if changed:
    backup_root=Path("/home/appontrack/backup")
    assert backup_root.is_dir() and not backup_root.is_symlink()
    archive=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="voice-no-mfa-signup-",dir=backup_root))
    os.chmod(archive,0o700)
    shutil.copy2(p,archive/"Signup.php")
    fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".signup-nomfa-",suffix=".php",dir=p.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf-8") as output:output.write(before.replace(old,new))
        shutil.copymode(p,temp)
        result=subprocess.run(["/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php","-l",temp],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
        assert result.returncode==0,"php_lint_failed"
        os.replace(temp,p)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp):os.remove(temp)
front=(root/"index.php").read_text();views=(root/"_core/Views.php").read_text()
assert "require __DIR__.'/_core/AdminMfa.php'" not in front
assert "mfa_gate_required(" not in front and "mfa_route(" not in front
assert "if(in_array($path,['/mfa','/mfa/setup'],true))" in front
assert "password_verify($pass," in front and "require_csrf();" in front and "$bad>=8" in front
assert "verify_external_sso_ticket($ticket)" in front
assert "echo card('التحقق بخطوتين'" not in views
assert new in p.read_text() and old not in p.read_text()
php="/opt/cpanel/ea-php83/root/usr/bin/php"
for file in [root/"index.php",root/"_core/Views.php",p]:
    c=subprocess.run([php,"-l",str(file)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
    assert c.returncode==0,"php_lint_"+file.name
print(json.dumps({"status":"deployed","signup_message_updated":changed,"site_login_otp_removed":True,"password_csrf_throttle_preserved":True,"sso_signature_preserved":True,"php_lint":"PASS","signup_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False))
